main.description: Tracks an individual member's completion of a reading/watching segment. Stored in the community's PDS repo. Each member has one progress record per segment.

segmentUri.description: AT-URI of the app.collectivesocial.group.segment this progress record belongs to

memberDid.description: DID of the member who completed this segment

completed.description: Whether the member has completed this segment

completedAt.description: When the member marked this segment as completed
